reviews.author: jeong taesan
reviews.text:
■Point to Five Seconds (025s) Seongsu, SOPHIE HICKS ARCHITECTS, 2025

1st floor. Brand and space introduction
2nd floor. Product testing
3rd floor. Tea Cafe (Tea courses can be reserved in advance, single items can be ordered on-site)

This is a store for the perfume brand Point to Five Seconds (025s), designed by SOPHIE HICKS ARCHITECTS, who designed the Acne Cheongdam store. The installation work is by another artist.

025s refers to the 250ms time it takes for a person to recognize a scent, and is also the name of the brand's signature perfume. And since the product names are expressed in time, it appears that all floors are connected by a spiral staircase with the intention of emphasizing the continuity of time. In that respect, the continuous slopes of the Jean Nouvel-designed Dolce & Gabbana Cheongdam store seem to be a good example.

There weren't many products, so there wasn't much to see, but it was impressive in that the unfamiliar brand remained deeply in my mind thanks to the minimalist yet bold space design.

reviews.author: ViKa
reviews.text:
TEA•THOLOGY is a cafe that offers Korean fusion tea ceremony. Designed by architect Sophie Hicks, the second floor houses the minimalist-designed Point to Five Seconds perfume flagship store. The third floor is the world of tea.
The tea is slowly and carefully brewed in front of the guests, showing them the entire process from start to finish.
This tea ceremony was conducted in collaboration with a Korean photographer, who took pictures with various teas. For example, black tea with a distinct floral scent symbolizes July, and yellow tea with a subtle herbal scent symbolizes April.
Desserts are also prepared in complete silence in front of guests, creating an atmosphere of contemplation.
The harmonious space and the scent of warm tea and desserts guide you into a world of meditation, and then take you out onto the streets of Seoul feeling refreshed.

reviews.author: Cheong
reviews.text:
I only knew the brand Point to Five Seconds as a perfume brand, but participating in the Dream Journey Tea Course held in Seongsu, Seoul was a completely new and touching experience.

The subtle flavor of Korean tea created the perfect harmony between tea and food, and the addition of storytelling elements made for a more tranquil and memorable time.

This is a truly special tea course that combines fragrance and tea culture, and is highly recommended to everyone visiting Seongsu.

If there is a course that combines incense and tea culture, I would definitely like to participate again.
